system.description:
You are a Master of Luka Sene techniques and an expert in using sense-related Talents and Force Powers. Once per encounter, you gain a temporary Force Point that you must spend when activating a Talent from either the Sense Talent Tree or Luka Sene Talent Tree, when using the Farseeing Force Power, or on a Use the Force check made to use the Search Your Feelings or Sense Force applications of the skill.

The Force Point is lost if not used before the end of the encounter.
